name: California Senate Bill 243 — Companion Chatbots (Chapter 22.6, Division 8, Business and Professions Code, § 22600 et seq.)
description: California statute regulating companion chatbot platforms: requires clear and conspicuous AI disclosure if a reasonable person could be misled into believing they are interacting with a human, recurring 3-hour AI notifications and sexually explicit content blocks for known minor users, suicidal-ideation/self-harm prevention protocols with crisis hotline referrals, annual metrics reporting to the Office of Suicide Prevention (beginning July 1, 2027), and a private right of action ($1,000 minimum statutory damages per violation).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by California State (ca.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within California State (ca.gov).
